## Reflection

Creating presentations with Quarto helped me realize that technical information does not have to be complicated to understand. Good presentation design combines organization, visuals, and storytelling so the audience can focus on the main message.

Being able to build both websites and presentations using the same platform has been one of the most useful technical skills I gained from this course.
